name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: A 5th-century rock fortress built by King Kashyapa, rising 200 m above the surrounding plains.

name: Ella
description: A hill-country village known for hiking trails, tea estates and the Nine Arches Bridge.

name: Mirissa Beach
description: A palm-fringed bay on the south coast, loved for golden sunsets, relaxed cafes and whale watching.

name: Anuradhapura
description: Sri Lanka's first great capital, home to gleaming white dagobas such as the Ruwanwelisaya and over 2,000 years of history.

name: Temple of the Tooth
description: The sacred Sri Dalada Maligawa in Kandy, which houses a relic of the tooth of the Buddha and hosts the grand Esala Perahera.

name: Arugam Bay
description: A laid-back east-coast surf town with a long curving beach, lagoons and fishing boats at sunrise.

name: Yala National Park
description: Famous for its leopards, plus elephants, buffalo, crocodiles and hundreds of bird species.

name: Ambuluwawa Tower
description: A spiral tower on a forested peak near Gampola with sweeping views over the central hills.

name: St Clair's Falls
description: A twin-tiered waterfall tumbling through tea country, often called the Little Niagara of Sri Lanka.

name: Coconut Tree Hill
description: A small red-earth headland crowned with coconut palms, a favourite viewpoint above the Mirissa coastline.
